announcements.text: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., Hawthorne, California (P00006, FA8811-25-D-B002); United Launch Services LLC, Centennial, Colorado (P00004, FA8811-25-D-B003); and Blue Origin LLC, Merritt Island, Florida (P00006, FA8811-25-D-B005), have been awarded contract modifications with a combined maximum ceiling value of $985,000,000 for National Security Space Launch, Phase Three, Lane Two launch services. Work will be performed at the contractors' respective facilities; Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Florida; Kennedy Space Center, Florida; and Vandenberg Space Force Base, California, and is expected to be completed by April 2033. No funds are being obligated at the time of award. The Space Systems Command, Space Access, Los Angeles Air Force Base, California, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Air Center Helicopters Inc.,* Burleson, Texas, is awarded an $87,357,186 firm-fixed-price contract (N3220527C1203) to provide vertical replenishment services. The Detachment will be forward deployed worldwide for extensive periods at sea. It is anticipated that the detachment will be primarily assigned to Combat Logistics Force ships of the T-AKE class and used to meet 5th and 6th fleet requirements. The contract contains a one-year base period, four one-year option periods, and an option to extend services for up to six months in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation 52.217-8. This contract will be funded incrementally in accordance with Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement 252.232-7007 using Navy appropriated funds that do not expire. Contract performance will commence on Nov. 29, 2026, and will conclude on May 28, 2032, if all options are exercised. The procurement was solicited via the Government Point of Entry website and one proposal was received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

extracted.description: Vertical replenishment services for T-AKE class Combat Logistics Force ships
extracted.competition: one proposal received, solicited via Government Point of Entry website

announcements.text: Meridian Medical Technologies LLC, St. Louis, Missouri, has been awarded a maximum $75,240,000 modification (P00003) exercising the first one-year option period of a one-year base contract (SPE2DP-26-D-0001) with two one-year option periods for antidote treatment nerve agent auto-injector. This is a firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract. The ordering period end date is Nov. 15, 2027. Using customers are Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, and Coast Guard. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2027 through 2028 defense working capital funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

announcements.text: Zero Waste Solutions,* Concord, California, was awarded a $33,717,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract for Fort Hood solid waste services. Bids were solicited via the internet with two received. Work locations and funding will be determined with each order, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 30, 2033. Army 418th Contracting Support Brigade, Fort Hood, Texas, is the contracting activity (W91151-27-D-A001).

announcements.text: Amentum Services Inc., Chantilly, Virginia, was awarded a $14,565,911 modification (P00118) to contract W58RGZ-25-C-0003 for global aviation maintenance services including pass-back maintenance support and level-of-effort support, installation of aircraft modifications, and aircraft reset to a mission-capable condition. This modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $416,844,290. Work will be performed in Marietta, and Savannah, Georgia; Wahiawa, Hawaii; Fort Campbell, Kentucky; Fort Polk, Louisiana; Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland; West Point, New York; Fort Bragg, North Carolina; Egypt, Germany, and Greece, with an estimated completion date of Nov. 30, 2027. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, Army; aircraft procurement, Army; and Foreign Military Sales (Germany, Greece, Netherlands, Slovakia, Sweden) funds, in the amount of $14,565,911 were obligated at the time of the award. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Stevedoring and Related Terminal Services, Anchorage, Alaska (HTC71127DE116), was awarded a $17,473,109 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract that provides services throughout various ports in Alaska, in connection with the import and export of Defense Transportation System sponsored and non-sponsored cargo. The contract has a total cumulative face value of $21,841,386. The base period of performance is from Nov. 15, 2026, through May 14, 2031. One offer was received. Fiscal 2027 Transportation working capital funds are being obligated at the time of award. Transportation Command Directorate of Acquisition, Scott Air Force Base, Illinois, is the contracting activity. (Awarded Nov. 12, 2026).
